hero.title: Custom
hero.subtitle: Hard-to-find replacement parts, custom components, and unique decorative items — serving Suntar, Yakutia, Sakha Republic. Printed locally and delivered fast. No minimum order, no shipping wait.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: From replacement parts to custom designs — we print what you need.

0.title: Replacement Parts
0.desc: Can't find a part for your car, appliance, or machine? We model and print hard-to-find components that are no longer manufactured.

1.title: Custom Parts
1.desc: Send us a sketch or measurements and we will design and print brackets, mounts, enclosures, and more.

2.title: Decorative Items
2.desc: Phone stands, cable organizers, planters, storage boxes, and other functional everyday items.

3.title: 3D Scanning & Modeling
3.desc: Have a broken part but no 3D file? We scan the original and recreate it digitally for printing.

process.title: How It Works
process.subtitle: Getting your part printed is easy.

step1.title: Describe Your Part
step1.desc: Send us a photo, sketch, or description of what you need.

step2.title: We Model It
step2.desc: Our team creates a 3D model based on your requirements.

step3.title: We Print It
step3.desc: Your part is printed with precision using quality materials.

step4.title: Pickup or Delivery
step4.desc: Collect locally or we ship it to you.

point1.desc: Most parts printed and ready within 24 hours. No weeks of waiting for online orders.
